rows.full_letter_text:
Dear Dr,

Diagnosis: symptomatic, structural right temporal lobe epilepsy
Subarachnoid haemorrhage (right MCA) 2017

Current antiepileptic medication: lamotrigine 75 mg twice a day.

Seizure type and frequency: focal seizures with loss of awareness, approximately 2 to 3 per month.

Investigations: CT head 2017, coil in situ plus low density right temporal lobe.

I reviewed this gentleman in clinic today. He continues to have what he calls absences and we discussed the treatment plan in full.

rows.full_letter_text:
Dear Colleague,

Diagnosis: focal epilepsy.

Current medication: levetiracetam 750 mg twice daily.

She reports no adverse effects and has remained well since her previous appointment. We agreed to continue the current regimen and review her again in six months.

Yours sincerely,
